integrity: The result includes an explicit high-pivot certificate and two different exact enumeration/rank implementations, with replayable recorded outputs; no external data files or nonstandard dependencies are needed.
scientific_limitations: Only non-toroidal ordinary boards of orders 7 through 12 are addressed; finite GF(2) rank witnesses establish real-rank lower bounds; no higher-order result, noise conditioning, or independent expert validation is claimed.
title: Sharp quadratic Walsh tomography for classical queens boards through order twelve
